name: The Money Alpha 360° Summit
venue: India Expo Centre & Mart, Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, Delhi-NCR, India
description: The Money Alpha 360° Summit is a major fintech and finance event held in Greater Noida uniting investments, wealth management, and emerging tech. Following an initial launch summit in April, the expansive main convergence is scheduled for later in the year.

name: CNBC Financial Advisor Award
description: Nominated for the CNBC Financial Advisor Award, recognizing excellence in financial advisory services.

name: Income Tax Discussion on Zee Business
description: Mukesh Gupta featured on Zee Business, sharing expert insights on income tax planning and strategy.

name: WC Event
description: At our annual wealth summit, we brought together over 150 HNI families under one roof for what turned out to be one of the most energising days our team has experienced. We had structured the day around three conversations we felt our clients needed most — navigating market volatility, succession planning for family-owned businesses, and the often-avoided topic of estate planning. What we did not anticipate was how openly and honestly our clients would engage once they realised the person sitting next to them was wrestling with the exact same questions.
